title: Fair Dinkum
blurb: Vegemite, footy, servos and backyard barbies. Truths and dares with an Aussie accent.

truth: What's the most Aussie thing you've ever done?
Vegemite: thin scrape or thick layer? Defend your answer.
What's your go-to order at the servo on a road trip?
What's the biggest spider you've ever shared a house with?
Which footy team do you go for, and why?
What's your top tip for the perfect Bunnings sausage?
What's the best beach you've ever swum at?
What's the closest call you've had with a dangerous Aussie animal?
Potato cake or scallop? Make your case.
What's on the menu at your ultimate backyard barbie?
What's a bit of Aussie slang you use way too much?
What would you pack for a road trip across the Nullarbor?
Have you ever lost a thong in the surf? Tell the story.
Which Aussie snack would you take to a desert island?
What's the hottest day you've ever survived, and how did you cope?
If you were an Aussie animal, which one would you be?
Beetroot on a burger: yes or no?
Who's the biggest legend you know personally, and why?
What's the most Australian thing about the town or suburb you grew up in?
Which Aussie TV show or ad jingle is stuck in your head for life?
Tim Tams: have you ever done a Tim Tam Slam, and who taught you?
What's the worst sunburn you've ever had, and where was the weirdest tan line?
What's an Aussie word you've had to explain to someone from overseas?
Meat pie with sauce, or no sauce? Be honest.
dare: Wrangle an imaginary crocodile in slow motion.
Do the Aussie salute: wave away imaginary flies for ten seconds.
Say "g'day mate" in five different accents.
Act out putting up a beach umbrella on a very windy day.
Do your best magpie swooping an unlucky cyclist.
Commentate the next turn like a footy commentator.
Walk across the room like you're crossing scorching hot sand.
Hop like a kangaroo to the other side of the room and back.
Name five Aussie animals in ten seconds.
Sing the first line of a classic Aussie song, any song you like.
Order from an imaginary drive-thru using as much Aussie slang as you can.
Bowl an imaginary cricket ball and celebrate taking the winning wicket.
Act out finding a huntsman behind the curtains while trying to stay calm.
Explain drop bears to the group with a completely straight face.
Give a 30-second fine dining review of a Bunnings sausage sizzle.
Give the group a lifesaver's safety talk about swimming between the flags.
Talk in a broad ocker accent until your next turn.
Do a victory dance like your team just won the grand final.
Do your best David Attenborough narrating a sheep shearing, 30 seconds.
Demonstrate the correct way to flip a snag on a barbie, with full tongs technique.
Do a slow-motion lifesaver rescue run across the beach to save an imaginary kid.
Act out being chased by a very angry cockatoo while holding a sausage roll.
Give a heartfelt eulogy for a thong that died at the beach.
Impersonate a servo attendant who has seen it all, serving a customer who wants only a Chiko roll.
